name: smwmusic-octopath-traveler-therion-the-thief
title: Octopath Traveler - Therion, the Thief
description:
Therion's theme, a somber and dramatic tune indicative of a chained heart in search of freedom from shackles both physical and emotional. Could be useful for cutscenes, overworlds, and maybe certain kinds of levels.

Also, this got 2nd place in the Covers category of Super Famicompo 6!
